mostWorthwhile.text: Making ATP and then using it to power the pump connected food and oxygen to a visible cell job.

leastWorthwhile.text: Supplying glucose to the cell was a fairly predictable intermediate step; it mainly set up the oxygen combination.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the pump moved particles toward the more crowded side, using ATP as it changed shape.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and labels pointed to the pairings. RNA was identified as a copy of a DNA instruction, though the details of how the ribosome reads it were not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing ATP used for two different cell jobs made me curious about what other structures do, although the pairings were mostly straightforward.
